messages:
Asha: Heads-up 1:30 PT partner checkpoint tomorrow. Need final perf/W curve, sustained throughput numbers, and the exact kernel flags we used. Partner wants a short blurb for the marketplace tile. Can we lock that down today? :calendar:

Diego: Running longer soak now. Preliminary numbers: perf/W improved, but there's variance at high seq lengths. Quick summary pasted below. Ill upload full CSV when done.

BenchBot: bench-run queued: job=soak-2755554321-diego status=RUNNING

Diego: Results snapshot:

```
node_type,model,seq,throughput,tokens_per_joule
m60,gpt-small,128,185 reqs/s,4200 t/J
m60,gpt-small,1024,120 reqs/s,4550 t/J
arm-x1,ggml-7b,128,90 reqs/s,3900 t/J
```

Diego: Kernel tweaks made: `--kv-prefetch=1 --kv-cache-max=2g --enable-simd` gives best steady-state on M60. On Ampere we left `--kv-cache-max=1g` and tuned batch_timeout to 6ms.

Ken: For the marketplace listing please give 1) immutable container tag, 2) one-sentence summary (<=140 chars), 3) p95 and sustained throughput numbers. Also need an approved 1200x600 screenshot.

LegalBot: Logo usage approved with partner-provided SVG. Attribution line must read: "PartnerName  Hardware provided by PartnerName." No other changes.

Asha: Proposed marketplace blurb (draft): "Up to 8% better energy efficiency at production sequence lengths; predictable throughput for p95-sensitive workloads." Please shorten if needed.

Diego: Uploaded artifacts: /shared/partner-bench/2755554321/full.csv, /shared/partner-bench/2755554321/throughput_chart.png. BenchBot notes: job completed.

BenchBot: bench-run completed: job=soak-2755554321-diego status=SUCCESS duration=4h05m artifacts=/s3/bench/soak-2755554321

Ken: Tagging release as `redwood/partner-market:2755554321-rc1`. Changelog (short): "kernel: kv prefetch + simd enable; batch_timeout tuning for Ampere"

Asha: Action items: Diego finalize p95 numbers (drop CSV path), Ken push rc tag and metadata to marketplace draft, Legal check copy for partner sign-off. Partner needs sign-off by 5pm PT. Anything blocking?

Diego: p95 export at /shared/partner-bench/2755554321/p95_export.csv. No blockers from my side.

Ken: Pushing metadata to marketplace draft now. Screenshot in the assets folder.

LegalBot: Copy approved for partner review, waiting on partner confirmation for the blurb.

Asha: Great. I'll run the partner call and walk through numbers. /cc @partner-team :phone:
